implementation: Guard nonempty increasing intervals and overflow in constant-offset endpoints before using a loop with removed checks. Compare its exclusive upper endpoint to nonnegative array length as unsigned. Normalize the REPL virtual-source key to match source lookup.
scope: No syntax changes and no Sloppy loop-optimization port yet. Overflowing proof arithmetic falls back to the original checked loop, preserving legal wrapped indexes and first-failure effects.

limits: Native 64-bit host. Warm filesystem caches; one build per binary.
C graph uses flat edges and a handwritten map; Dewy uses per-node arrays and an insertion-ordered map.
String equality uses separately allocated payloads; C uses pointer/length pairs and libc memcmp, Dewy uses runtime strings.
Kernel times exclude input generation; wall times include the complete process.
Thread CPU timing excludes descheduling, but CPU frequency and cache contention still matter.

focused_coverage: Native/WebAssembly, default/release: huge unsigned limits; signed high/low endpoint arithmetic; valid negative starts and wrapped unsigned indexes; empty ranges; do-first loops; failure order after prior effects.

The final focused run strengthens offset cases to enter the actual optimization: +2 avoids reusing the counter increment, and +(-1) preserves an add rather than a subtract instruction. Compiler sources are unchanged from the full-suite run.
REPL with a trailing directory separator in TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP; subsequent submissions and private record copies.
